criteria.text: Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.
Calculates the Earn-out Payment as $3,000,000 (3 x ($5,300,000 - $4,000,000), subject to the $3,000,000 cap) and identifies that the Seller's figure of $3,600,000 is wrong.
Calculates the long-stop date as 22 September 2027 (120 days after signing on 25 May 2027) and identifies that expected clearance on 6 October 2027 falls after it, recommending an extension.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 14 February 2029 (18 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 14 August 2030 (36 months after Closing).

Identifies that the Bellhaven Media Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Shows the earn-out arithmetic and flags the discrepancy between $3,000,000 and the Seller's $3,600,000.
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
